title: Voice meeting-notes product brief
instruction: Bot-free meeting assistants (Granola, Fathom) are the breakout productivity trend. Write a one-page product brief for a voice-notes-to-action-items tool for tradies: problem, 3 features, what it must never do.

input_material.text: Granola and Fathom top 2026 meeting-assistant lists; Granola captures device audio without a bot joining the call.
